mentions.name: bleep
mentions.description: A simple interval timer CLI written in Go that beeps at configured intervals. Features include a verbose mode with a live countdown, pause/resume via signals, and a JSON output mode that integrates with Waybar to show a status-bar timer that changes color when counting, paused, or beeping, with click-to-pause. Useful for pomodoro sessions, work tracking, and kitchen reminders. Distributed as an AUR package (bleep-bin), with builds and publishing automated via GoReleaser.
mentions.problem: Needed a simple reminder tool to beep at intervals, inspired by needing to know when to stir while cooking bolognese.
mentions.source_excerpt: It's called bleep, a simple interval timer that beeps.
